local-first voice notes · ios + macos

[ quill ]

record → transcribe → structured notes, entirely on your device. no account, no cloud, no subscription — your recordings are folders you own.

github.com/Sma1lboy/quill how it works

zero cost

Whisper large-v3 turbo + Apple's system LLM run on the Neural Engine. No API bills, no audio ever leaving the phone.

fast · concurrent

Decode workers scale to the memory actually available; ~3s per 8s of audio on recent iPhones, whole sessions batch through a queue.

apple intelligence

Notes structured by the on-device foundation model, with a local Qwen fallback when it can't run. Auto-titles included.

checkpointed batch

Long files slice adaptively with per-slice checkpoints — an hour-long recording survives any interruption and resumes mid-file.

speakers, split

Offline diarization labels multi-voice transcripts S1/S2 — meetings and interviews read like scripts, not walls of text.

live activity

Recording shows a live timer + waveform on the Dynamic Island; transcription shows a spinner with a real percentage.

quill is an extension of digimata/quill — the minimal macOS meeting recorder whose audio core and "folders you own" philosophy it inherits. packaging informed by tape · design language from kobe
